[SWS_CM_11354] Execution Context for setting Subscription State change handler
⌈
For the SetSubscriptionStateChangeHandler method de-
scribed in [SWS_CM_00333] a second overload with an additional input parameter
shall be provided. This parameter shall provide an executioner object in which Set-
SubscriptionStateChangeHandler shall be invoked. The minimum behaviour of
the Execution Context is defined in [SWS_CM_11364].
template<typename ExecutorT>
ara::core::Result<void> SetSubscriptionStateChangeHandler(
ara::com::SubscriptionStateChangeHandler handler, ExecutorT&& executor);
For the first overload without an execution context argument an implementation de-
fined default execution context (like in previous AUTOSAR releases) shall be used.
⌋
